steps.message: Record an audio clip and save it with name "MZ8d_storytelling.m4a" using Audio Recorder app.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i -E 'audio|recorder|sound|voice'; echo '---dirs---'; ls -d /sdcard/* 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'record|audio|sound|music|voice' || true; echo '---bins---'; which tinycap; which screenrecord; which recorder; which ffmpeg; which sox"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i -E 'audio|recorder|sound|voice'; echo '---dirs---'; ls -d /sdcard/* 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'record|audio|sound|music|voice' || true; echo '---bins---'; which tinycap; which screenrecord; which recorder; which ffmpeg; which sox""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "echo '---recordings---'; ls -la /sdcard/Recordings 2>/dev/null; echo '---m4a---'; find /sdcard -maxdepth 4 -type f -name '*.m4a' 2>/dev/null | head -n 50; echo '---audio ext in Recordings---'; find /sdcard/Recordings -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "echo '---recordings---'; ls -la /sdcard/Recordings 2>/dev/null; echo '---m4a---'; find /sdcard -maxdepth 4 -type f -name '*.m4a' 2>/dev/null | head -n 50; echo '---audio ext in Recordings---'; find /sdcard/Recordings -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,80p'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "rm -f /sdcard/Recordings/MZ8d_storytelling.m4a; tinycap /sdcard/Recordings/MZ8d_storytelling.m4a -T 3; ls -l /sdcard/Recordings/MZ8d_storytelling.m4a; am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d file:///sdcard/Recordings/MZ8d_storytelling.m4a; am force-stop com.dimowner.audiorecorder"
